description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Ponyback Brigade, adding {R}.
Ponyback Brigade dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Ponyback Brigade from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Ponyback Brigade enters the battlefield, creating three 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Skirk Prospector three times by sacrificing the Goblins, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
